name: Old Tern
text: Fly South. When this comes home: your other Birds away come home too.
golden_text: Fly South, for 1 turn. When this comes home: your other Birds away come home too.

source.note: As amended by Pass 2 design: review calls in DECISIONS.md.

details: They land in your hand. Their When played text fires again when you play them. Landed Birds cannot fly that turn; a full hand leaves them on the doorstep.

1.text: When this comes home: your other Birds away come home too.
